reviews.text: Very special place 🌟❤️
Everything perfect

It's a good place to go for a consultation, but the wait time is unnecessary. I waited almost four hours, and they attended to other people who arrived after me. One of the guys who helped me had his food in one hand and was holding documents in the other. When it was finally my turn, I waited another half hour alone in that office; apparently, they forgot to let them know I was waiting because they went to lunch.

This place won't treat your exotic bird. They made us wait two hours only to tell us that the veterinarian magically got sick right before seeing our bird, wasting our time and playing with the life of an animal that needs care. If they don't treat birds, they should say so, but don't waste our time. The girl at the front desk tricked us by giving us an appointment they never kept, and they made us wait for nothing. It's not fair. Anyway, don't take your birds here; go to places that say "Avian and Exotic Animal Clinic." This is unethical.
Spectacular service and the best and most humane doctor ever.

The worth place to take a pet
Waiting, and waiting.  The doctor bravo should not be there.  If he doesn't like his jab. Make people wait .

Staff were friendly and accommodating—provided me with a box to put my cat into. The doctor was sweet and took extra measures to find the source of my cats discomfort. The clinic is pleasing to be inside of as well. Overall I had a great experience and would recommend this clinic!
I take both of my dogs to Bravo and I am very happy to the medical attention and office staff.
Great facility and amazing staff.  I've been with them for almost  15 years with multiple dogs.

I am extremely disappointed with the care my cat received at this clinic. During a recent visit, my cat’s whiskers were cut without my knowledge or consent, and I was only informed after it had already been done. At no point before the procedure was I asked for permission or advised that this would take place. (See pictures attached at the end)

When I contacted the clinic to seek an explanation, I was initially told that the whiskers had to be cut because the area was infected. However, after reviewing photos taken before the visit, it did not appear that the area was infected. Later, the explanation changed, and we were simply told that they were sorry and that nothing could be done because “what is done is done.”

As a pet owner, I expect honesty, professionalism, and clear communication regarding any procedure performed on my animal. Whiskers are an important sensory tool for cats, and altering them without first discussing it with the owner demonstrates poor communication and a lack of professionalism.

Since the visit, my cat has appeared withdrawn, less playful, and has shown changes in his normal behavior, which has been very upsetting for our family. Pets are not just animals they are beloved members of the family and deserve to be treated with compassion, experience, and respect.

This experience has raised serious concerns for me about the level of care and communication provided at this clinic. If something as significant as this can happen without first informing the owner, it raises concerns about the overall standard of care provided.

Unfortunately, based on my experience, I cannot recommend this clinic to other pet owners. I am also considering submitting a complaint to the Florida Board of Veterinary Medicine for review, as I believe pet owners deserve transparency, professionalism, and informed communication regarding the care of their animals.

Pets are not just animals they are members of our families, and they deserve to be treated with the highest level of care and respect.

I’ve had multiple visits with Dr. Bravo and his staff for my multiple dogs and cat and every experience has been consistently positive.

All of my visits have been walk-ins, so I always expect a bit of a wait since scheduled appointments are being seen as well. Despite that, the staff does their best to keep things moving and remain kind and professional throughout.

Dr. Bravo stands out for his honesty and clear communication. He takes the time to explain all possible scenarios for your pet’s situation and walks you through the best options without pressure. I always feel like I understand what is going on and what the realistic outcomes are.

The staff is caring, patient, and treats both pets and owners with compassion, even during stressful visits.

I’m very grateful for the care my dogs have received here and would recommend Dr. Bravo and his team to anyone looking for a vet who is straightforward, thorough, and genuinely cares about animals.

A close friend of mine brought her cat here for a routine neutering procedure. The cat was reportedly left in a cage for approximately seven hours before surgery. No pre-operative testing was performed, yet the procedure went ahead despite concerns that the cat was extremely stressed and fearful.

After the surgery, the cat was placed back in a crate, and tragically, he passed away shortly afterward.

This situation raises serious questions about the level of care, medical judgment, and monitoring provided. If the cat was considered too stressed or unstable, why was the procedure performed without additional precautions or testing? Losing a beloved pet under these circumstances is devastating.

Based on this experience, I would not recommend this clinic. Pet owners deserve transparency, proper pre-operative evaluation, and the highest standard of care for their animals.
Excellent doctor and the prices are reasonable.
Excellent service, very professional

Short of personel, I notice 1 doctor. They are  great workers
And very knowledgeable.
Whenever I take my cats there, I receive excellent service...Thank you!

Been going there for years, but the service has gone downhill. Wait times have always been bad but they’re worse now. They have a new vet that doesn’t speak English and I only speak English. I spent $2000 getting some test done on my dog and they never called me back to give me the results. Avoid this place at all costs.

My dog Mars, (Maltipoo), was a rescue, he would not let anyone groom him, but Bravo handled it! Thanks Barbara! (his groomer) he looks great and you're incredible! My husband Wayne and I love Bravo Animal Clinic. Best place for your animals!!
Nice office with polite and professional staff. They handled our dog with the utmost care.

Excellent place Dr. Bravo is wonderful and the staff was beyond great.  Thanks to all of them.

Anyways, I wanted to leave a five star review because the staff is very sweet and very kind from my experience experiences that I’ve been there multiple times the doctor is phenomenal! So he is an excellent veterinarian and I can vouch for this as I am a breeder of dogs and I’ve been to so many vets and nobody not one. Spends the time with you that this Dr does! So if you’re looking for a vet whether it’s a dog cat or yes, a parrot he’s the Vet for your pet!

takes too long

I rescued two kittens from the street and took them to Bravo clinic. I showed up with my two kids and the kittens in my hands, exactly how you’d expect someone to show up after a rescue. Instead of understanding that, the staff acted annoyed and made rude comments because I didn’t have carriers. I had literally just found the kittens on the street. I thought a veterinary clinic would appreciate someone trying to help animals, not judge them for not having everything perfect.

They gave me a cardboard box and put us in an exam room, telling me the doctor would be right in. Then nothing. I sat in that cold room with two scared kittens and two kids for more than two hours without a single update. No one checked on us. People kept peeking through the window but never actually came inside.

What made it even more frustrating was that I kept hearing clients coming in and out of the clinic, chatting with the vet and the team, having long conversations about everything under the sun… yet not one single person could step into my room for 10 seconds to let me know what was going on. They clearly had the time to talk to other people, but not to acknowledge someone who had been waiting for hours.

I fully understand that clinics get busy. I have no issue waiting if someone communicates with me. The problem is the complete lack of respect and zero effort to update me. If I hadn’t walked out a few times to ask, I would probably still be there waiting.

The only time the doctor spoke to me was when I finally gave up and walked out upset. And even then, he just told me that if I still wanted the kittens seen, I would have to wait even longer.

I went there after doing something good and trying to help these kittens. Instead of support, I was met with disrespect and zero empathy. If someone had simply communicated with me, updated me, or explained the situation, it would have been a completely different experience.

I do not recommend Bravo Clinic. If you value your time, your pets, or basic respect, choose another vet.

Most negative reviews regarding Bravo relate to wait time.  We had a 2:30 pm appointment and waited until just after 3:30 pm before we finally left.  Three staff members saw us sitting there with three kittens, but not one of them addressed the lengthy wait time.  When we finally inquired about our appointment, we were told that that Dr. Bravo had been in a complicated surgery since 2:30 pm.  When we arrived at the clinic at 2:15 pm, no one else was in the waiting room.  If it was true that he was in surgery, someone should have explained that to us.  Instead, we were left sitting over an hour.  Very bad first impression!!  READ ALL REVIEWS, ESPECIALLY THE NEGATIVE ONES, BEFORE  MAKING AN APPOINTMENT AT THIS CLINIC.  I read the reviews too late . . . shame on me.
Thank you Dr. Bravo for giving my girl a painless send off. She's no longer suffering. I love you Zoe. Thank you for 13 years of unconditional love. Watch over Krypto and Emma. Until we meet again.
We went there last year with an appointment, 3 hours later they still hadn't called us. We ended up leaving....
Excellent customer and pet care; the doctor and her assistants are very friendly and answer all questions.
Total professional staff. Warm and caring. Call me to check on both dogs that were neutered. Would recommend Bravo to everyone. I would give them 6 stars if I could.
No comment.

Dr. Bravo, Dr. Arellano, and the staff at Bravo animal clinic are very professional and deeply care for the animals they treat. We have taken our two dogs and our cat over the last 5 years and have always received excellent care, advice, and genuine support. Thank you!

Dr Bravo needs no introduction, nor good reviews as he has plenty but I do want to share my experience and it goes way beyond his medical knowledge. This wasn’t the first time I take one of my dogs to Dr Bravo and certainly won’t be my last but it made an impact. My boy was pretty sick. He was pretty sick when he got to Dr Bravo and had been under the care of another veterinarian. Dr Bravo took his time looked over my boy , handled him with compassion and care as did ALL of his staff from front desk to techs. He suggested I take him to a specialist , which I took my boy to and to no avail because they wouldn’t listen to what had already be done which may have really set him back. After trying for weeks with the specialist and 3 other veterinarians . I went back to Dr Bravo and he put his best effort on a very sick dog to do what none of the other Drs had done because he cared because my boy mattered to him. Dr Bravo is what every vet should strive to be , he takes his oath to heart and a true example of what a veterinary clinic and their staff should be. They weren’t only great with Riggins, they were great to both of us. When I read reviews complaining about wait times etc I say there’s a reason why there’s a wait time. They’re taking their time to make sure they aren’t missing anything on dogs like my Riggins , dogs that need that extra time. Owners that need a little extra time saying goodbye and maybe handling a dog that needs a soft hand. To me  they are undeniably the best Dr and staff. Thank you all for helping Riggins and I . I especially want to thank Dr Bravo, Lucy, Alicia and all of the techs that laid their hands on him to try and make him better and save him …. He thanks you too.

Absolutely the worst vet experience I've ever had in my entire life. I had an appointment at 12:00pm and arrived at 11:50am to check in. It took almost an hour to call my dog in, even though I arrived early. (Which is understandable, in this profession) what ISNT understandable was everything after. When they saw my dog they suddenly changed their minds and said to wait 5 minutes. For reference my dog has a muzzle on. Then they took us outside and around the back and stuck us in a storage closet for over an hour. Some lady came in to grab something out of the closet and had the audacity to criticize my choice of treats for my dog (pork) claimed it was unhealthy, and made a snide comment about "it must be your culture" my mom is a POC and was with me the whole time. Eventually I flagged down a vet tech and asked how long it was going to take for my dog to be seen and she said the vet was working on some birds and I would be seen after. Soon they took us out of the storage closet and placed us in an ACTUAL room. We waited im not sure how long after. Eventually the birds left and despite the birds leaving they saw SEVERAL animals that arrived after us. I asked again when we would be seen and she said soon so I decided to leave without being seen as it was past 3:00pm at that point I couldn't keep my dog there any longer as he was starting to get more and more terrified since he's not a fan of the vet (and what dog is) Do not go to this vet if you want a kind and compassionate service. Go if you like waiting hours and hours for no apparent reason.

This place is the best! The staff is so friendly, the doctor is so special and caring, and you can tell his focus is 100% on your pets, not on money like you often see at other vets. Without hesitation, I've taken all my pets here (guinea pigs, gerbils, and two dogs). After visiting many other vets, I can confidently say this is the best place you can go.

*I love the place; it's so beautiful, with all the details in the decor, and being able to greet Lola when I arrive makes it even better (Lola is the parrot 🦜).

Charge a price first & later changed the price!!
Won’t recommend to anyone!!
Dr. Bravo and his team are truly amazing people who care about your babies. They’ve taken great care of our two dogs and now cat.
Amazing doctor and office staff!!!

Dr. Bravo should get an award for his patience , his heart and caring and going above and beyond his call of duty. He saved my chihuahua and her puppies, and answered our phone call after hours and met us at the clinic and performed surgery on her. He is truly our hero. We were down and out and he helped us. We cannot thank him enough. No other veterinarian would have done what he did. We are truly grateful.

I never knew that I never had a review for this place until I was talking about it to recommend to a friend. Sadly I had to move to central Florida but I wish I could take my rabbit here. I love this place. Everyone is nice and I have always enjoyed the atmosphere. I took my rabbit here ever since I had her 4 years ago and has always taken her there since.
The staff were friendly and timely. The establishment was clean and orderly. The Dr. was professional and knowledgeable. It was a positive experience.

Absolutely not. I am DEVASTATED. I have been rescuing and rehabbing dogs for years and I recently rescued a dumped dog who I have been fostering and getting healthy for over a month. I came to Bravo clinic to have her spayed so she could go to her new home with everything done and her health in check. The spay was through a grant this clinic receives but they still managed to charge me $160 for bloodwork I never received. 2 hours after bringing my rescue home, she started to HEAVILY bleed from her incision site. No, it was not “drainage” it was dripping and spilling heavy blood. To the point where she couldn’t stand. So of course, she has now been at the emergency vet clinic for over two hours. Apparently an artery was nicked and no one noticed?? I was also told the stitches were extremely loose. Not to mention none of her legs were shaved so where exactly were fluids placed? Was a catheter even used? Now she’s still oozing blood and emergency vets have to go back into her to see WHY SHE IS STILL BLEEDING FROM A SIMPLE SPAY PROCEDURE. I didn’t even receive a breakdown of what was done during surgery or what was used as far as meds. DO NOT BRING YOUR ANIMALS HERE. I AM AT A LOSS FOR WORDS AT THIS HORROR.

I found a very sick STRAY cat in my backyard, squealing in pain.  Rushed it to Bravo and had a terrible experience there! The staff is friendly but they immediately without even doing an exam proposed a treatment plan costing almost $700.  I declined that and they said they could do something more reasonable and sat me in a room and took the cat.  I waited in there 1 1/2 hours and then the vet, Luzzelena Rodriguez came in to tell me the cost would be under $300.  I asked her what sex the cat was and she admitted that she hadn't even examined the cat yet!  How can you know how much it'll cost before you even look at the animal? After another hour they came out with the cat and some medication and told me it was a female and that her body temperature was very low.  I asked how low, what was the exact temperature and Luzzelena Rodriguez wasn't even sure of the number,  she just said it was low and that I needed to keep her on a heating pad. I paid the $265 bill which covered the exam, a vitamin pack, Ivermectin, Penicillin, some SQ fluids and 2 meds-Rebound and Liqui-Tinic.  I took her home around 3pm and immediately put her on a heating pad.
She died early the next morning. How could this "Vet" not know how bad she was and if she did why wouldn't she tell me?
Bravo called me the next afternoon to check up on her and I told them she had passed away that morning!
In my opinion, this woman, Luzzelena Rodriguez does not know what she's doing and I would NEVER entrust my animal to her!
Very busy good animal hospital but expect a very long wait

Thank you so much.
Ivette Rosario.

Taking care of my Pet Princess

MY FIRST VISIT REVIEW: ( I’m   not sure anymore..  i liked the first impression of the vet and the doctor was very attentive and informative . Despite multiple visits, I have found that the wait often exceeds two hours, even when I have a scheduled appointment. Once taken to the exam room, the wait continues, adding to the frustration. It is perplexing why appointments are made if the wait times are so extensive. The waiting room often appears empty, which only adds to the confusion. I hope the management addresses these issues to improve the overall experience for their clients.

Best vet and staff in town. I applaud Alicia, Lucy, Dr.Fernandez and Dr.Bravo for their amazing work and love towards all of my babies. Thank you for being so kind and patient with my pets and myself.

One of the best places. One of the most caring veterinarians I have ever had the pleasure of dealing with. The male doctor. Dr. Bravo is the most caring, loving individual. He truly cares. I would never go anywhere else. Thank you so much for your kind spirit and helping us through such a hard moment. Julio and Lori Enriquez

They said they had called my dog even though we were sitting in the lobby, I never received a phone call they simply skipped our turn. Then, when we were finally brought to a room I was told the Doctor would be going to lunch PRIOR to seeing us. They DO NOT value your time or take into consideration your pets condition.
I've had very good experiences with Bravo veterinary.  I would like some feed back on the boarding services since it's my first time using this service for my little one.

they’re very nice people that’s about all i can say. they ignored my voice explaining that my dog wasn’t just “bored” and itchy clawing himself till he bleeds, i’m currently in their office waiting for my appointment that was scheduled at 2:30 days prior . it’s currently 3:43 pm and had to physically find someone at the front desk to ask when we would finally see someone, as the vet techs have only used our room as a hallway to get to the front of the building. we finally heard from a tech @ 3:46 that the doctor had an emergency and will be here soon.. if you have the spare hours and like to hear ppl laughing around u then this is the place

This happened a few years back, but I don’t think I ever wrote a review about it. Bravo Animal Hospital has seen my pets intermittently during the last 10 years (huskies, cats, birds and a bearded dragon). A few years ago a black lab few months old showed up on my driveway and was sleeping on my porch when I left water and food, and since on our street cars literally fly by, we decided to take her to our backyard, to keep her safe, I didn’t want to bring her inside in case of any disease or fleas/ticks, and I had 2 huskies and 2 cats then. Next day I took her to Bravo, I was not planning to keep her, just wanted to get her fixed, vaccinated and check up to foster her and have her ready for adoption. When I mentioned that to them, they actually gave me a special fee, very low cost. It was amazing, so I was able to foster her  and keep my pets safe as well. She got adopted within a month. I suggest to always make an appointment since waiting times can be long if you are a walk in, they get a lot of patients. Dr Bravo, Dr Arellano, Alicia, Lucy and the rest of the staff are awesome people.

Excellent! The staff's attention is wonderful. They took great care of my little hamster, and he survived, which we thought wasn't possible. The doctor made it happen, and he's going to be fine. Thank you, Bravo Animal Clinic! 🙏 …
Excellent clinic, large waiting area, very clean, pleasant staff. I drove a friend there. If I lived in the area I'd likely be a client
They are very professional, caring staff who really care for your pet. I have been with them for over 9 years. I would recommend them to anyone.

This place does not value your time, money, or your animal. Avoid this place, go literally anywhere else. They will over charge and ramp up your bill at the last minute and blind side your with extra charges. …

The care your animal gets is awesome.  However when you show up first thing in the morning 8:30 when they’re doors open & you go without an appointment you expect to wait. But when three people without appointments were taken before me, I …
